description: This file implements the base class for vision (computer vision) services within the project, providing abstract methods for image analysis and handling frame processing workflows.

classes.name: VisionService
classes.description: Base class for vision services, providing methods to process image frames and generate textual descriptions or answers. It inherits from AIService and defines an abstract method run_vision for subclasses to implement specific vision functionalities.

methods.name: __init__(self, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the vision service, extending the AIService initialization and setting up internal state.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_vision(self, frame: UserImageRawFrame)
methods.description: An abstract method that subclasses must implement to process an image frame and yield analysis results such as descriptions or answers.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Handles processing of incoming frames, invoking run_vision for UserImageRawFrame objects, and managing metrics tracking.

ctags.name: process_frame
ctags.pattern: /^    async def process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection):$/

ctags.name: run_vision
ctags.pattern: /^    async def run_vision(self, frame: UserImageRawFrame) -> AsyncGenerator[Frame, None]:$/
